title: validateFunctionSignaturesJSON
summary: Validate the JSON syntax of function-signature metadata text.

gpu_support.notes: This validator runs on host text. Numeric and provider-resident values are rejected before provider or metadata access.

tested.unit: crates/runmat-runtime/src/builtins/common/validation.rs validates valid and invalid JSON payloads
tested.integration: Registered as a callable compatibility builtin; not an arguments-block validator.

description: `validateFunctionSignaturesJSON(S)` accepts text containing JSON and throws if any payload is not syntactically valid JSON. This JSON-payload signature is a RunMat language extension; the compatibility target's filename-based and no-input forms are not yet implemented.
behaviors: Accepts string scalars/arrays, character row vectors, and compatible cell arrays of text.
Parses each text payload as JSON and throws a structured RunMat error on syntax errors.
Returns no user-facing value when validation passes and suppresses automatic output.
Numeric values, including native integer values, are rejected before provider or metadata access.

examples.description: Validate JSON syntax for signature metadata
examples.output: No output when the JSON payload parses successfully.

faqs.question: Does this validate the full MATLAB signature schema?
faqs.answer: No. RunMat currently validates JSON syntax only; full signature-schema semantic validation is not implemented.
